structured_output.digest_summary: Day of building loopwatch v0.2 (revival PRD and Phases 1–3 implementation). Two critical finds: a self-ingestion bug in the previous design (headless runs persisting transcripts under ~/.claude/projects/) with a three-layer fix, and a two-tier extraction pattern (Haiku triage → Sonnet writing) for cost-efficient knowledge capture. Phase 1 ships correctness and cost budgeting; Phase 2 adds privacy redaction with fail-closed post-scan.
highlights: Identified and fixed self-ingestion cost compounding: headless claude -p runs persist transcripts in ~/.claude/projects/<encoded-cwd>/, which the next night's collector re-ingests. Fix is three-layer: --no-session-persistence flag, fixed run dir with suffix-matching exclusion, and cwd-based filtering.

Two-tier extraction pattern: Haiku (cheap, triage only, read-only tools) emits candidates + digest; Sonnet (expensive, writing) reads only the cited excerpts. Cost-efficient on quiet days; full quality on signal days.

Privacy redaction strategy: gitignored redact.list (secrets + client names) applied before model sees the bundle, then post-scanned on output with fail-closed page drops. Suitable for unattended pipelines with unredacted transcripts.

Fixed three watermark correctness bugs: partial-line loss (watermark stops at last newline), truncated-file handling (reset when size < old offset), and hashed state keys instead of absolute paths leaking client names in git.
Designed catalog deployment as PR-per-run to a separate private repo with Vercel Deployment Protection, replacing the v0.1.0 push-to-main model.

candidates.title: Self-ingestion debugging: headless claude -p session persistence and three-layer fix
candidates.why: Non-obvious root cause (CLI persists transcripts in ~/.claude/projects even on headless runs) with a robust three-layer fix (--no-session-persistence + fixed run dir + cwd filtering) designed to survive CLI changes.

candidates.title: Two-tier extraction: cheap triage (Haiku) + expensive writing (Sonnet) on signal only
candidates.why: Reusable pattern for cost-efficient knowledge capture: Haiku reads whole bundle, emits candidates + digest; Sonnet runs only if candidates non-empty and reads only cited excerpts. Stays cheap on quiet days, full quality on signal days.

candidates.title: Privacy redaction in unattended pipelines: gitignored list + pre-model scrub + post-scan drops
candidates.why: Substantive pattern for handling secrets and client names in headless extraction: redact.list is applied before the model sees anything, then post-scanned on output with fail-closed page drops. Avoids leaking sensitive data to public catalogs.

candidates.title: Watermark correctness: three bugs fixed (partial-line loss, truncation, path leaks)
candidates.why: Three specific bugs in byte-offset watermarking shipped in Phase 1: watermark must stop at last newline (not file size), reset on truncation (size < old), and use hashed keys not absolute paths to avoid leaking client names in git.
